audience: agencies and service teams that run projects, hours and invoices in Gripp

useCases.title: Review the active projects and their managers
useCases.text: List the projects that are not archived. See the phase, company, account manager and totals of each one.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices per company
useCases.text: List the invoices with their status and open amount. Open one invoice to read its lines and see what the company must pay.

useCases.title: Report hours on a project for a period
useCases.text: List the time registrations of a month with date, employee, task and status. Add them up to check the budget of a project.

useCases.title: Register hours after a client call
useCases.text: Create a time registration on a project for an employee. Use the concept status to keep the entry editable. Each call creates a new record.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task from a meeting
useCases.text: Create a task in Gripp with a description. Each call creates a new task, so do not repeat it.

useCases.title: Add a contact person to a company
useCases.text: Find the company, then create a contact person with name, e-mail and phone. Each call creates a new contact.
